purpose: Observe the currently verified daily model with fixed weights and policy while new completed-session features arrive
anchor_selection: Current verified artifact at registration, without searching archived performance or fitting a new model
promotion: Never automatic; observation counts permit review only, not a performance pass
rules: Freeze model bytes, threshold, universe, horizon, costs, feature code and library versions before issuing shadow forecasts.
Do not backfill forecasts or rewrite first-issued predictions. Only publish after the completed-session buffer and before the next entry open.
Retain exact feature inputs and source hashes with each first-issued forecast.
Score every complete timely cohort, including failures, with first-observed outcomes and separate revision records.
Do not pool shadow evidence with daily models or change thresholds, coverage requirements or parameters from observed outcomes.
Use the existing verified cache and download lock; shadow work makes no network requests and never fits a model.
A changed implementation, environment or policy blocks shadow issuance pending a separately registered study.
All outputs are research-only and never place trades or replace the daily model.
